reasons.plausibility: Aluminum is not sufficiently noble to form a protective Al₂O₃ scale in the presence of highly reactive elements like Hf, Ti, and Zr, which will oxidize internally and disrupt scale continuity, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed falsification test is clear and well-defined, directly comparing oxidation resistance and mechanical properties between Al-doped and baseline alloys under the specified conditions.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a critical limitation of the alloy, but its core mechanism is fundamentally flawed, so pursuing it would misdirect research effort.
